How future tiers will work

  • S — Repeated benefit: at least three matched pairs, all critical checks passed, acceptance no worse than baseline and a demonstrated task-relevant benefit.
  • A — Useful alternative: task-tested critical checks pass; repeated advantage is not yet established.
  • B — Limited fit: observed limitations restrict useful cases; explain the fallback.

Eligibility is not an automatic award. Source-only editorial picks stay separate; insufficient evidence stays unranked. Severe unresolved risk blocks recommendation. We compare tools within a task, never all skills on one universal leaderboard.
